Mechanism decisions: (1) ONE hand-state (flight controls ON/OFF) governs every ship hand-input (W/S throttle, Q/E roll, mouse joystick) and the HUD; autopilot may fly IFF hands-OFF; hands-OFF absorbs the 2026-06-27 free-look behaviors (free cursor aim/select, LMB-drag look). Whether hand-state reuses _scManual+freeLook.latched or becomes a dedicated flag is the architect/build call — the contract binds the observables, not the representation. (2) Z from hands-on = controls off + tour start; Z mid-tour = tour stop, land hands-off coasting. F mid-tour = takeover (tour stops, hands-on). The tour W/S-takeover branch (main.js:9598-9611) is retired for tours. (3) Boot flip: bootModeAction carries startAutopilot=(mode==='helm'); warpRevealSystem HELM branch starts the tour hands-off, ORRERY branch arms nothing; dismissTitleScreen's unconditional _autopilotEnabled=true (main.js:2647) removed; mobile coercion in _pickBootMode (main.js:2637) removed so mobile offers both stations. (4) Idle-timeout tour fires only in HELM (both idle branches main.js:8331-8357 gated). GUARDRAILS: SC_TUNING never touched; SupercruisePilot/AutoNavigator/tourStandoff motion code untouched (this workstream owns regime/input/HUD/boot, not flight); Assist-type player burns explicitly out of scope.
